summary: Cabot Corporation filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $1.3 billion unsecured revolving credit agreement with a syndicate of lenders, maturing May 12, 2031. The facility replaces a $1 billion and a €300 million revolver, both terminated concurrently. Borrowings will be used for general corporate purposes, with interest at Term Benchmark or RFR Spread plus 0.68%-1.20% based on credit ratings. Financial covenant limits net debt/EBITDA to 3.75x (4.25x post-material acquisition). This routine refinancing does not constitute a special situation; it is a standard credit facility renewal and termination of prior agreements, with no acquisition, divestiture, or strategic event involved. No deal terms are applicable.
